OEM / ODM PARTNERSHIP

Build a food waste processor program around your brand.

We support B2B project discussions for brands, importers and distributors — from existing product selection and private labeling to appearance customization and new-product development.

CUSTOMIZATION SUPPORT

Practical options across the product program.

The exact scope depends on the selected product platform, target market and project requirements. We review each request before confirming feasibility, specifications, order quantity and timing.

01 / BRANDING

Private-label branding

Discuss custom logo placement and brand presentation for the selected product.

02 / APPEARANCE

Appearance coordination

Coordinate selected colors, exterior details and industrial-design adjustments where the platform allows.

03 / PACKAGING

Retail-ready packaging

Discuss packaging artwork, carton requirements and localized user manuals for the intended market.

04 / CONFIGURATION

Product configuration

Review inner-container size, product dimensions and configuration compatibility for the selected design.

05 / ELECTRICAL

Market requirements

Discuss voltage, plug type and other agreed electrical specifications for technical review.

06 / DEVELOPMENT

New product development

For suitable projects, discuss product customization, development coordination and samples.

COOPERATION DETAILS

Clear starting points for your project.

MINIMUM ORDER

MOQ: 500 units or more

Project quantities are reviewed against the selected product and customization scope.

SAMPLE ORDERS

Sample orders supported

Sample development or proofing fees apply; the amount is discussed and confirmed for each project.

DELIVERY

Lead time by order

Delivery lead time is confirmed according to the order and production arrangement.

EXPORT

Export packaging

Export packaging can be discussed as part of the order requirements.

FACTORY VISIT

Customer factory inspection

Customer factory inspections are accepted by arrangement.

PAYMENT

Payment terms by discussion

Available payment methods and applicable terms are provided during commercial discussion.

PROJECT WORKFLOW

From first brief to shipment planning.

01

Share your brief

Tell us the market, preferred design, capacity range, target positioning and estimated quantity.

02

Review feasibility

Discuss product fit, customization scope, electrical requirements and documentation needs.

03

Confirm samples

Align on sample evaluation, artwork, packaging and the specifications for approval.

04

Plan production

Confirm quality criteria, commercial terms, production schedule and shipping arrangements.

OEM & ODM buyer questions

OEM & ODM buyer questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The MOQ for OEM and ODM cooperation is 500 units or more.

Can you customize products for our brand?

Options include custom logos, packaging and user manuals, product appearance and colors, and voltage, plugs or specifications, subject to project confirmation.

Are sample orders available?

Yes. Sample orders are supported. Sample development or proofing fees apply; the amount is confirmed for each project.

Can customers inspect the factory?

Yes. Customer factory inspections are accepted. Export packaging is supported, and delivery lead time is confirmed according to the order.

LET'S DISCUSS YOUR PROJECT

Tell us what your market needs.

Send your target market, preferred product appearance, required configuration and estimated order quantity. Our team can review the next steps with you.

最小注文数量（MOQ）はいくつですか？

OEM・ODM協業の最小注文数量は500台以上です。

OEM／ODM 合作常見問題

OEM／ODM 合作常見問題

最低訂購量是多少？

OEM／ODM 合作的最低訂購量為 500 台以上。

可以依照我們的品牌進行客製嗎？

支援 LOGO、包裝與說明書、產品外觀及顏色，以及電壓、插頭和規格客製，實際內容以專案確認為準。

是否接受樣品訂單？

接受樣品訂單。樣品開發或打樣會產生相關費用，金額依專案確認。

客戶可以到工廠驗廠嗎？

接受客戶工廠驗廠，並支援出口包裝。交期依照訂單內容確認。

洽談您的專案

告訴我們您的市場需求。

請提供目標市場、偏好的產品外觀、所需配置及預估訂購數量，我們將與您討論後續安排。
